sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: This episode was originally released on Casefile's Patreon, Apple Premium, and Spotify Premium feeds as an early bonus for our paid subscribers.
sentences.zh: 本集最初作为付费订阅者的早期福利，发布在 Casefile 的 Patreon、Apple Premium 和 Spotify Premium 频道上。

sentences.en: These episodes are designed to be slightly shorter, allowing us to cover a broader range of cases.
sentences.zh: 这些剧集旨在做得稍短一些，以便我们能涵盖更广泛的案件。

sentences.en: To receive these episodes early and ad-free, you can support Casefile on your preferred platform.
sentences.zh: 如需提前收听这些无广告剧集，您可以在您偏好的平台上支持 Casefile。

sentences.en: It was around 4.30am on Tuesday, May 11, 2021, when Haralambos Anognostopoulos, better known as Babos, was violently woken in bed.
sentences.zh: 2021年5月11日星期二凌晨4点30分左右，哈拉兰博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯（人称“巴博斯”）在睡梦中被暴力惊醒。
zh_words: 博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: Babos rented a two-storey maisonette in the affluent suburb of Glikonera on the outskirts of Athens, Greece.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯在希腊雅典郊外的富人区格利科内拉租了一栋两层复式公寓。

sentences.en: He had little time to react as three intruders wearing hoods and motorcycle balaclavas grabbed him.
sentences.zh: 还没等他反应过来，三名戴着头套和摩托车面罩的入侵者就抓住了他。

sentences.en: A scuffle ensued, but Babos was quickly overpowered by the men, who were armed with pistols.
sentences.zh: 双方发生了扭打，但巴博斯很快被那些手持手枪的歹徒制服。

sentences.en: They swiftly tied Babos up and blindfolded him with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速将巴博斯捆绑起来，并用胶带蒙住了他的眼睛。

sentences.en: Babos could do little as the intruders launched on his wife, 19-year-old Caroline Crouch.
sentences.zh: 当入侵者扑向他19岁的妻子卡罗琳·克劳奇时，巴博斯无能为力。

sentences.en: The chaos startled the couple's 11-month-old daughter, who was sleeping close by, and began to cry.
sentences.zh: 混乱惊醒了这对夫妇睡在附近的11个月大的女儿，孩子开始大哭起来。

sentences.en: The men spoke in broken Greek with Albanian accents.
sentences.zh: 歹徒说着带有阿尔巴尼亚口音、蹩脚的希腊语。

sentences.en: They repeatedly asked, where is the money?
sentences.zh: 他们反复逼问：“钱在哪里？”

sentences.en: Days earlier, Babos and Caroline had bought a plot of land to build their dream family home.
sentences.zh: 几天前，巴博斯和卡罗琳刚买了一块地，准备建造他们梦想中的家庭住宅。

sentences.en: Caroline's parents had gifted them 50,000 euros to facilitate the purchase.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的父母赠予了他们5万欧元以促成这次购买。

sentences.en: In preparation for construction costs, the couple had hidden a little over 10,000 euros in their house.
sentences.zh: 为了支付建筑费用，这对夫妇在家里藏了略多于1万欧元的现金。

sentences.en: It was common for people in Greece to store cash at home, as the banks were unreliable and in constant risk of bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 在希腊，人们习惯在家中存放现金，因为银行不可靠且时刻面临破产风险。

sentences.en: Wanting to end their torment quickly, Babos told the intruders exactly where they could find the money.
sentences.zh: 为了尽快结束折磨，巴博斯告诉了入侵者藏钱的具体位置。

sentences.en: It was stored inside a Monopoly board game box.
sentences.zh: 钱就藏在大富翁棋盘游戏的盒子里。

sentences.en: The men pocketed the loot, but remained in the house, roaming from room to room, snatching jewellery and other valuables.
sentences.zh: 歹徒拿走了赃款，但仍留在屋内，在各个房间里搜寻，抢走了珠宝和其他贵重物品。

sentences.en: They demanded more money.
sentences.zh: 他们索要更多的钱。

sentences.en: With nothing else to offer, all Babos and Caroline could do was beg for their lives.
sentences.zh: 由于再也拿不出东西，巴博斯和卡罗琳只能苦苦哀求他们饶命。

sentences.en: The intruders then held a gun against the baby's head.
sentences.zh: 随后，入侵者将枪抵在了婴儿的头上。

sentences.en: Caroline began screaming.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳开始尖叫。

sentences.en: Babos couldn't see what was happening, but his wife's panicked screams soon fell silent.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯看不见发生了什么，但妻子惊恐的尖叫声很快消失了。

sentences.en: Babos fought desperately against his restraints.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯拼命挣扎，试图摆脱束缚。

sentences.en: The tape around his neck was painfully tight and he kept drifting in and out of consciousness.
sentences.zh: 脖子上的胶带勒得他生疼，他感觉自己不断地陷入昏迷又清醒过来。

sentences.en: Babos awoke after one fainting spell to discover the man had gone.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯在一次昏厥后醒来，发现歹徒已经离开了。

sentences.en: The only thing he could hear was his daughter wailing.
sentences.zh: 他唯一能听到的就是女儿的哭声。

sentences.en: It took about half an hour, but Babos finally manoeuvred himself over to his mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 大约过了半小时，巴博斯终于挪到了手机旁。

sentences.en: Using his nose, he dialed the number for emergency services.
sentences.zh: 他用鼻子拨通了紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: Upon hearing the operator on the other line, Babos cried out,
sentences.zh: 听到电话那头接线员的声音，巴博斯大喊道：

sentences.en: Help!
sentences.zh: 救命！

sentences.en: Help!
sentences.zh: 救命！

sentences.en: Help!
sentences.zh: 救命！

sentences.en: Ambulance!
sentences.zh: 救护车！

sentences.en: Ambulance!
sentences.zh: 救护车！

sentences.en: The duct tape around his mouth muffled his words and he was barely intelligible.
sentences.zh: 嘴上的胶带让他的声音变得模糊不清，几乎无法辨认。

sentences.en: The operator asked him to calm down and explain what was going on.
sentences.zh: 接线员让他冷静下来，并说明发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Robbers came in, was all Babos managed, before he broke down.
sentences.zh: “强盗进来了，”巴博斯只说了这一句，便崩溃了。

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: “你在哪里？”

sentences.en: the operator asked.
sentences.zh: 接线员问道。

sentences.en: Glick-a-nera!
sentences.zh: “格利科内拉！”

sentences.en: Glick-a-nera!
sentences.zh: “格利科内拉！”

sentences.en: Babos yelled.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯大喊道。

sentences.en: By the time first responders arrived, it was approaching 6am.
sentences.zh: 当急救人员赶到时，时间已接近凌晨6点。

sentences.en: They raced up the front steps and entered the home.
sentences.zh: 他们冲上台阶进入屋内。

sentences.en: The living space and kitchen had been ransacked.
sentences.zh: 客厅和厨房已被洗劫一空。

sentences.en: Drawers were open and empty, with belongings and clothing strewn about.
sentences.zh: 抽屉敞开着，空空如也，物品和衣物散落一地。

sentences.en: A Monopoly box lay open on the floor.
sentences.zh: 地板上放着一个打开的大富翁盒子。

sentences.en: A small indoor security camera had been torn off a living room wall and left behind a couch.
sentences.zh: 一个小型室内监控摄像头被从客厅墙上扯下，丢在沙发后面。

sentences.en: Its memory card was missing.
sentences.zh: 它的存储卡不见了。

sentences.en: Dangling from a staircase banister was a brown and white husky puppy.
sentences.zh: 楼梯扶手上悬挂着一只棕白相间的哈士奇幼犬。

sentences.en: She was hanging by her own leash, dead.
sentences.zh: 它被自己的牵引绳吊着，已经死了。

sentences.en: Upstairs in the main bedroom, police found Babos Sanognostopoulos on the floor, his hands and feet restrained tightly behind his back.
sentences.zh: 在楼上的主卧，警方发现巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯躺在地板上，手脚被紧紧反绑在身后。
zh_words: 巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: His eyes and mouth were covered in duct tape that circled down to his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛和嘴巴被胶带缠住，一直缠到了脖子上。

sentences.en: Laying face down on the bed nearby was Caroline Crouch.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳·克劳奇面朝下躺在旁边的床上。

sentences.en: Her baby girl was half on top of her, crying while clapping, pushing and hitting her mother's body, doing anything she could to rouse her.
sentences.zh: 她的女婴半趴在她身上，一边哭一边拍打、推搡着母亲的身体，试图唤醒她。

sentences.en: Although the baby was in distress, she was physically unharmed.
sentences.zh: 虽然婴儿受到了惊吓，但身体并无大碍。

sentences.en: Caroline, on the other hand, was so pale, it was immediately clear she was deceased.
sentences.zh: 而卡罗琳脸色惨白，一眼就能看出她已经去世了。

sentences.en: Babos was released.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯被解开了束缚。

sentences.en: When he saw his wife's body, he was visibly shocked.
sentences.zh: 当他看到妻子的遗体时，明显受到了极大的震惊。

sentences.en: Once the child was safe with an officer, Babos detailed the violent home invasion.
sentences.zh: 在孩子被警察带走安置后，巴博斯详细描述了这起暴力入室抢劫案。

sentences.en: Based on his account and an examination of the crime scene, police concluded that three men had broken in while a fourth kept to watch outside.
sentences.zh: 根据他的陈述和对犯罪现场的勘查，警方断定有三名男子闯入，第四名同伙在外面放哨。

sentences.en: They'd likely followed an obscured dirt path that led to the rear of the house.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能是沿着一条隐蔽的土路摸到了屋后。

sentences.en: Upon failing to break into a back door, they removed security pins from a basement window and climbed in through that.
sentences.zh: 在试图破开后门失败后，他们拆除了地下室窗户的安全销，从那里爬了进去。

sentences.en: Once inside, the men silenced the family's seven-month-old husky, Roxy, by choking her with her leash and throwing her over the banister, strangling her to death.
sentences.zh: 进入屋内后，歹徒用牵引绳勒死了家里的七个月大的哈士奇 Roxy，并将它扔过扶手。

sentences.en: The men then confronted Babos and Caroline asleep in the bedroom.
sentences.zh: 随后，歹徒在卧室里与熟睡的巴博斯和卡罗琳对峙。

sentences.en: They spent over an hour ransacking the house before Caroline was smothered to death with a pillow.
sentences.zh: 他们花了超过一个小时洗劫房屋，最后用枕头闷死了卡罗琳。

sentences.en: A coroner concluded Caroline had endured an agonising, not instant death, with the attack lasting up to six minutes.
sentences.zh: 验尸官断定卡罗琳经历了一场痛苦的、并非瞬间的死亡，袭击过程持续了长达六分钟。

sentences.en: Bruising on her lips and tongue appeared to have been caused by a sharp object.
sentences.zh: 她嘴唇和舌头上的淤青似乎是由尖锐物体造成的。

sentences.en: Other bruises across Caroline's body indicated she'd put up a fight, but there were no signs of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳身上其他的淤青表明她曾进行过反抗，但没有迹象表明她遭受了性侵。

sentences.en: Babos's description of coming in and out of consciousness suggested he had suffered hypoxia, a potentially fatal lack of oxygen.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯描述的昏迷状态表明他患有缺氧症，这是一种可能致命的缺氧状况。

sentences.en: The intruders likely mistook Babos for dead and left, thinking there were no witnesses to their crime.
sentences.zh: 入侵者很可能误以为巴博斯已经死了，便离开了，以为没有目击者。

sentences.en: Babos would have died too, had his attackers not inadvertently left him with a tiny field of vision through his duct tape blindfold.
sentences.zh: 如果袭击者没有无意中让他通过胶带的缝隙看到一点点视野，巴博斯可能也已经死了。

sentences.en: This enabled him to find his nightstand, where his mobile phone was located.
sentences.zh: 这让他得以找到床头柜，手机就在那里。

sentences.en: Despite the damage done to the couple's home, the perpetrators had left no clear evidence behind.
sentences.zh: 尽管这对夫妇的家被破坏得很严重，但作案者没有留下任何明确的证据。

sentences.en: Yet, one of the men's balaclavas had slipped during the initial struggle with Babos and he'd gotten a brief glimpse of the man.
sentences.zh: 然而，其中一名歹徒的面罩在与巴博斯最初的扭打中滑落，他瞥见了那人的长相。

sentences.en: A composite sketch was created, depicting a tall, dark-skinned, overweight male who was under 30 years old.
sentences.zh: 警方绘制了一张嫌疑人画像，描述为一名30岁以下、身材高大、皮肤黝黑、体型肥胖的男性。

sentences.en: Babos was also able to identify two of the handguns the assailants were carrying, a silver colt and a black pistol.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯还认出了歹徒携带的两把手枪：一把银色柯尔特手枪和一把黑色手枪。

sentences.en: All up, the perpetrators escaped with over 10,000 euros in cash and around 20,000 euros worth of jewellery.
sentences.zh: 总计，作案者抢走了超过1万欧元的现金和价值约2万欧元的珠宝。

sentences.en: Police were certain those responsible were professional criminals.
sentences.zh: 警方确信作案者是职业罪犯。

sentences.en: They had likely watched Babos and Caroline for some time, familiarising themselves with the family's routine before choosing the opportune moment to strike.
sentences.zh: 他们很可能已经监视巴博斯和卡罗琳一段时间了，在选择最佳作案时机前，已经熟悉了这家人的作息。

sentences.en: While gang-led killings were not unusual in Greece, the slaughter of a mother in front of her baby shocked the country.
sentences.zh: 虽然帮派谋杀在希腊并不罕见，但当着婴儿的面屠杀母亲的行为震惊了全国。

sentences.en: A police spokesperson said,
sentences.zh: 警方发言人表示：

sentences.en: We've seen several other ugly murders throughout the years, but this was extremely brutal and violent.
sentences.zh: “多年来我们见过不少恶性谋杀案，但这起案件极其残忍和暴力。”

sentences.en: It took someone with a strong antisocial personality and a distinct lack of emotion to carry out such a heinous act.
sentences.zh: “只有具备强烈反社会人格且极度冷血的人，才能做出如此令人发指的行为。”

sentences.en: One investigator remarked, In a robbery, the motive is money.
sentences.zh: 一位调查人员评论道：“在抢劫案中，动机通常是钱。”

sentences.en: It was not necessary to kill to achieve this goal.
sentences.zh: “为了达到这个目的，根本没必要杀人。”

sentences.en: Therefore, the question on everyone's minds was, why was Caroline Crouch killed?
sentences.zh: 因此，每个人心中都在问：为什么卡罗琳·克劳奇会被杀？

sentences.en: It was speculated that the intruders had been high on drugs and unable to control their actions.
sentences.zh: 有人推测入侵者可能吸了毒，无法控制自己的行为。

sentences.en: Perhaps Caroline got a decent look at them, or knew them.
sentences.zh: 也许卡罗琳看清了他们的长相，或者认识他们。

sentences.en: Caroline was also a black belt kickboxer.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳还是一位黑带跆拳道选手。

sentences.en: She might have fought back with a level of strength or skill the invaders didn't anticipate, so they killed her to keep her under control.
sentences.zh: 她可能进行了入侵者意想不到的顽强抵抗，所以他们为了控制住她而杀了她。

sentences.en: Maybe her frantic screaming after a gun was pressed to her daughter's temple forced them to silence her before alarms were raised.
sentences.zh: 也许在枪抵住她女儿太阳穴后，她疯狂的尖叫声迫使歹徒在警报拉响前让她闭嘴。

sentences.en: Given that the perpetrators knew to ask for the money the couple had stashed away, the only thing investigators ascertained with any degree of certainty
sentences.zh: 鉴于作案者知道索要这对夫妇藏起来的钱，调查人员唯一能确定的一点是

sentences.en: was that the attack was premeditated.
sentences.zh: 这次袭击是蓄谋已久的。

sentences.en: Those in Babis and Caroline's inner circle were questioned.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯和卡罗琳的核心圈子成员都受到了盘问。

sentences.en: Perhaps someone among them had tipped off the gang.
sentences.zh: 也许他们中间有人给犯罪团伙通风报信。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, security footage collected from nearby homes and businesses showed a dark-coloured car cruising around the couple's house on the morning of the crime.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，从附近住宅和企业收集的监控录像显示，案发当天早上，一辆深色汽车在受害者家附近徘徊。

sentences.en: It was closely followed by a motorbike.
sentences.zh: 后面紧跟着一辆摩托车。

sentences.en: The vehicles were filmed turning along the streets that led to Babis and Caroline's home.
sentences.zh: 这些车辆被拍到转入通往巴博斯和卡罗琳家的街道。

sentences.en: Three days after her murder, Caroline Crouch was laid to rest on the Greek island of Alonisos.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生三天后，卡罗琳·克劳奇在希腊阿洛尼索斯岛下葬。

sentences.en: She'd lived there since she was two, her parents having fallen in love with the idyllic coastal surroundings and decided to relocate there from England.
sentences.zh: 她从两岁起就住在那儿，她的父母爱上了那里田园诗般的海岸环境，决定从英国搬到那里。

sentences.en: Caroline embraced her beachside upbringing, developing a passion for scuba diving and swimming.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳拥抱了她的海滨成长环境，培养了对水肺潜水和游泳的热爱。

sentences.en: It was on Alonisos during a Good Friday parade in 2017 where Caroline met and fell in love with Babis Anognostopoulos, a handsome and successful commercial helicopter pilot.
sentences.zh: 2017年的耶稣受难日游行期间，卡罗琳在阿洛尼索斯遇到了巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯，并坠入爱河，他是一位英俊且事业有成的商用直升机飞行员。
zh_words: 巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: Paying tribute to his late wife, Babis said,
sentences.zh: 巴博斯在悼念亡妻时说：

sentences.en: I was lucky that I met you, very lucky that you loved me and even more lucky that you are the mother of my child.
sentences.zh: “我很幸运遇到了你，很幸运你爱我，更幸运的是你是我们孩子的母亲。”

sentences.en: She will grow up not remembering her wonderful mother, but Caroline, who was the joy of life, will always be near me through our daughter.
sentences.zh: “她长大后不会记得她伟大的母亲，但卡罗琳，你是生命的喜悦，将永远通过我们的女儿陪伴在我身边。”

sentences.en: As Caroline Crouch was being laid to rest, police in northeast Greece pulled a car over for a routine stop.
sentences.zh: 就在卡罗琳·克劳奇下葬时，希腊东北部的警察拦下了一辆车进行例行检查。

sentences.en: The 36-year-old male driver was a Georgian national who was en route to the Bulgarian border.
sentences.zh: 36岁的男司机是一名格鲁吉亚公民，正前往保加利亚边境。

sentences.en: He handed over his passport for identification, but it was quickly determined to be a fake.
sentences.zh: 他交出了护照以供核实，但很快被确定为伪造。

sentences.en: As it turned out, the man was Georgie Haradzishwili, a violent criminal with multiple convictions.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，此人是乔治·哈拉齐什维利，一名有多次犯罪记录的暴力罪犯。

sentences.en: He was wanted in relation to 12 break-ins committed around Athens over the past six months.
sentences.zh: 他因过去六个月在雅典周边犯下的12起入室盗窃案而被通缉。

sentences.en: Three were around Caroline Crouch's neighbourhood of Glickanera.
sentences.zh: 其中三起发生在卡罗琳·克劳奇居住的格利科内拉附近。

sentences.en: One was in December the previous year.
sentences.zh: 其中一起发生在去年12月。

sentences.en: Haradzishwili and three others broke into a house via a rear window and dragged the female occupant by her hair before threatening to slit her throat.
sentences.zh: 哈拉齐什维利和其他三人通过后窗闯入一户人家，揪住女住户的头发，威胁要割断她的喉咙。

sentences.en: The offenders made off with almost 10,000 euros in cash as well as jewellery.
sentences.zh: 罪犯抢走了近1万欧元的现金以及珠宝。

sentences.en: On March 7, two months before Babas and Caroline were targeted,
sentences.zh: 3月7日，即巴博斯和卡罗琳成为目标的前两个月，

sentences.en: Haradzishwili and four accomplices tied up an elderly couple and their cleaning lady during a home invasion.
sentences.zh: 哈拉齐什维利和四名同伙在一次入室抢劫中捆绑了一对老年夫妇和他们的清洁工。

sentences.en: They made off with cash and other valuables.
sentences.zh: 他们抢走了现金和其他贵重物品。

sentences.en: Haradzishwili bore remarkable similarities to the composite sketch Babas had helped create.
sentences.zh: 哈拉齐什维利与巴博斯协助绘制的嫌疑人画像有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: Given his Georgian roots, history of carrying out violent break-ins with the gang and his attempt to flee the country,
sentences.zh: 鉴于他的格鲁吉亚背景、参与暴力入室抢劫团伙的历史以及他试图逃离国家的行为，

sentences.en: police were confident that they had finally found Caroline's killer.
sentences.zh: 警方确信他们终于找到了卡罗琳的凶手。

sentences.en: Georgie Haradzishwili was placed under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 乔治·哈拉齐什维利被逮捕。

sentences.en: He was interrogated for four days straight, during which he was tied up and beaten by interviewing officers.
sentences.zh: 他连续接受了四天的审讯，期间被审讯人员捆绑并殴打。

sentences.en: Haradzishwili's treatment at the hands of police left him concussed.
sentences.zh: 哈拉齐什维利在警方的遭遇导致他脑震荡。

sentences.en: He maintained that he had never heard of Caroline Crouch and when evidence against him came up dry,
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己从未听说过卡罗琳·克劳奇，当针对他的证据落空时，

sentences.en: Haradzishwili was cleared of any involvement in her murder.
sentences.zh: 哈拉齐什维利被洗清了与她谋杀案有关的嫌疑。

sentences.en: Three officers were demoted from the Athens Homicide Squad for the treatment Georgie Haradzishwili endured while in custody.
sentences.zh: 三名警官因乔治·哈拉齐什维利在拘留期间遭受的对待而被雅典凶杀组降职。

sentences.en: Police set their sights on a local Albanian organised crime group.
sentences.zh: 警方将目光投向了当地的一个阿尔巴尼亚有组织犯罪集团。

sentences.en: Eventually, they whittled a list of 100 potential suspects down to just 10 people.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们将100名潜在嫌疑人的名单缩小到了10人。

sentences.en: These individuals were on what detectives referred to as the Red List, known criminals with a penchant for being particularly cruel.
sentences.zh: 这些人被侦探们称为“红名单”，都是以残忍著称的知名罪犯。

sentences.en: Baba Sanognostopoulos was shown mugshots of the suspects, though police wouldn't divulge any further insight into their identities.
sentences.zh: 巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯观看了嫌疑人的照片，但警方没有透露关于他们身份的任何进一步信息。
zh_words: 巴博斯·阿诺格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: They're all hardcore criminals of different nationalities.
sentences.zh: “他们都是来自不同国家的硬核罪犯。”

sentences.en: Albanians, Georgians and Greeks may all have been involved.
sentences.zh: “阿尔巴尼亚人、格鲁吉亚人和希腊人都可能参与其中。”

sentences.en: Organised crime knows no frontiers, was all a detective was willing to say, before adding,
sentences.zh: 一位侦探只愿意说“有组织犯罪没有国界”，随后补充道：

sentences.en: It's a difficult case.
sentences.zh: “这是一个棘手的案件。”

sentences.en: It's taken longer than we thought to get here, but we are getting closer.
sentences.zh: “走到这一步比我们预想的要久，但我们正在接近真相。”

sentences.en: Members of the public were starting to lose patience as racial hostilities grew.
sentences.zh: 随着种族敌对情绪的增长，公众开始失去耐心。

sentences.en: A 300,000 euro reward for information went unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 一笔30万欧元的线索悬赏金无人认领。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, robberies and burglaries continued throughout Athens, leaving residents fearful someone else would soon be killed.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，雅典各地的抢劫和盗窃案仍在继续，居民们担心很快就会有其他人遇害。

sentences.en: A criminologist told The Sun Online,
sentences.zh: 一位犯罪学家告诉《太阳报》在线版：

sentences.en: If this was an ordinary burglary, it would have been solved by now.
sentences.zh: “如果这是一起普通的入室盗窃案，现在应该早就破案了。”

sentences.en: We read that there is no DNA, no fingerprints, that there is little evidence, and yet they seem like amateurs.
sentences.zh: 我们读到说现场没有DNA，没有指纹，证据很少，但他们看起来却像业余人士。

sentences.en: Something is not right.
sentences.zh: 有些地方不对劲。

sentences.en: But Caroline's loved ones remained grateful for the investigative effort, with her husband telling reporters,
sentences.zh: 但卡罗琳的亲人们依然对调查工作心存感激，她的丈夫告诉记者：

sentences.en: I hope what happened to me and my family and my wife's family never happens again.
sentences.zh: 我希望发生在我、我的家人以及我妻子家人身上的事，永远不要再发生。

sentences.en: The police know how to do their job, and they will find them.
sentences.zh: 警察知道如何做好他们的工作，他们会找到凶手的。

sentences.en: Despite the emotional toll,
sentences.zh: 尽管承受着巨大的情感创伤，

sentences.en: Babis continued to front the media to keep his wife's case in the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯还是继续面对媒体，以让公众保持对妻子案件的关注。

sentences.en: He willingly fielded questions from journalists via his Instagram account while expressing his gratitude for the outpouring of support he was receiving from around the world.
sentences.zh: 他通过自己的Instagram账号欣然接受记者的提问，并表达了他对来自世界各地的支持浪潮的感激之情。

sentences.en: On June 17, 2021,
37 days after Caroline Crouch was killed, police revealed they were closer than ever to tracking down her killer, though they didn't elaborate.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗琳·克劳奇遇害37天后，警方透露他们比以往任何时候都更接近追踪到凶手，尽管他们没有详述。

sentences.en: That same day, a small memorial service was held for Caroline on Alonisos.
sentences.zh: 同一天，在阿洛尼索斯岛为卡罗琳举行了一场小型追悼会。

sentences.en: Mourners soon noticed that detectives had arrived.
sentences.zh: 哀悼者很快注意到侦探们已经到达。

sentences.en: The detectives waited for the service to conclude before discreetly approaching Babis Sanognostopoulos and asking him to escort them to Athens.
sentences.zh: 侦探们等仪式结束后，才谨慎地接近巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯，并请他陪同他们前往雅典。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: Important information had emerged and there was a new suspect.
sentences.zh: 重要信息已经浮出水面，出现了一名新的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: They urged Babis to come and help identify the man.
sentences.zh: 他们敦促巴比斯去协助指认那个人。

sentences.en: Babis agreed.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯同意了。

sentences.en: He approached Caroline's mother, Susan, to give her the update.
sentences.zh: 他走近卡罗琳的母亲苏珊，向她告知了最新进展。

sentences.en: He gave her a tearful embrace before preparing to depart for Athens.
sentences.zh: 他含泪拥抱了她，然后准备动身前往雅典。

sentences.en: Investigators had followed up a host of leads that emerged from Babis' recollections of the night his wife was killed, but all had reached dead ends.
sentences.zh: 调查人员追踪了从巴比斯对妻子遇害当晚的回忆中产生的大量线索，但所有线索都走进了死胡同。

sentences.en: Over time, several details didn't appear to add up.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，一些细节似乎对不上号。

sentences.en: Detectives had failed to uncover indisputable evidence that the basement window had been breached by intruders.
sentences.zh: 侦探们未能发现确凿证据表明地下室窗户曾被入侵者破坏。

sentences.en: The window was very small, raising doubts that several men, one of whom Babis said was tall and overweight, could access the house in this way.
sentences.zh: 窗户非常小，这让人怀疑巴比斯所说的几名男子——其中一人据称身材高大且超重——是否能以这种方式进入屋内。

sentences.en: And although Babis and Caroline's house had been ransacked, something about the mess felt remarkably polished for a violent home invasion.
sentences.zh: 尽管巴比斯和卡罗琳的家被翻得乱七八糟，但对于一起暴力入室抢劫案来说，这种混乱显得过于刻意了。

sentences.en: The only thing a neighbour had heard was the sound of the couple's puppy crying in distress.
sentences.zh: 邻居听到的唯一声音是这对夫妇的小狗因痛苦而发出的叫声。

sentences.en: They didn't hear any ransacking, screams, calls for help, or a baby crying.
sentences.zh: 他们没有听到任何翻箱倒柜的声音、尖叫声、求救声或婴儿的哭声。

sentences.en: Most perplexing was the absence of foreign fingerprints or biological material in the house.
sentences.zh: 最令人困惑的是屋内没有发现任何外人的指纹或生物材料。

sentences.en: This was unheard of, and investigators wondered how the offenders had gotten so lucky.
sentences.zh: 这闻所未闻，调查人员纳闷罪犯怎么会如此幸运。

sentences.en: It was also unusual for home invaders to restrain a male victim and leave him unharmed while opting to fight a female victim.
sentences.zh: 入室抢劫者制服男性受害者却让他毫发无损，反而选择攻击女性受害者，这也极不寻常。

sentences.en: Not a single piece of forensic evidence was uncovered on Caroline's body, despite the fact she had fought her attacker for upwards of six minutes.
sentences.zh: 尽管卡罗琳与袭击者搏斗了长达六分钟以上，但她的尸体上没有发现任何法医证据。

sentences.en: Even swabs taken from underneath her fingernails came back negative for any outside DNA.
sentences.zh: 甚至从她指甲下提取的拭子检测结果也显示没有外来DNA。

sentences.en: Then there was the matter of the home security camera, which was found damaged in the living room.
sentences.zh: 还有客厅里那台被发现损坏的家庭监控摄像头的问题。

sentences.en: It is common for criminals to take security cameras with them, but in this instance, the offender had merely removed the memory card.
sentences.zh: 罪犯带走监控摄像头很常见，但在本案中，罪犯仅仅取走了存储卡。

sentences.en: Data revealed the card had been removed at 1.20am,
sentences.zh: 数据显示存储卡是在凌晨1点20分被取出的，

sentences.en: yet Babis said the thieves broke in at 4.30am.
sentences.zh: 然而巴比斯说小偷是在凌晨4点30分闯入的。

sentences.en: At the time of her death,
sentences.zh: 在她去世时，

sentences.en: Caroline Crouch was wearing a smartwatch that automatically monitored her pulse.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳·克劳奇佩戴着一块自动监测脉搏的智能手表。

sentences.en: At 3.58am, her heart rate indicated she was fast asleep.
sentences.zh: 凌晨3点58分，她的心率显示她正处于熟睡状态。

sentences.en: At 4.05am, her pulse increased abruptly by 50%, showing she was in an extreme state of mental or physical stress.
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点05分，她的脉搏突然增加了50%，表明她处于极度的精神或身体压力状态。

sentences.en: At 4.11am,
sentences.zh: 凌晨4点11分，

sentences.en: Caroline's heart stopped beating altogether.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的心脏彻底停止了跳动。

sentences.en: This too was before the time
sentences.zh: 这也发生在该时间点之前，

sentences.en: Babis said she must have been murdered.
sentences.zh: 即巴比斯所说她一定被谋杀的时间。

sentences.en: An examination of Babis' phone revealed he had a fitness app installed that tracked his physical activity.
sentences.zh: 对巴比斯手机的检查显示，他安装了一款追踪身体活动的健身应用程序。

sentences.en: Data from the night of the crime showed he was moving around at the exact time he'd supposedly been tied up and blindfolded by the alleged intruders.
sentences.zh: 犯罪当晚的数据显示，在他声称被所谓的入侵者捆绑并蒙住双眼的时间段里，他实际上正在走动。

sentences.en: Police also attempted to reenact
sentences.zh: 警方还试图重演

sentences.en: Babis' claim that he used his nose to dial emergency services on his phone's touch screen.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯声称他用鼻子在手机触摸屏上拨打紧急服务电话的过程。

sentences.en: At the time, he'd been tightly restrained from head to toe and blindfolded with duct tape.
sentences.zh: 当时，他从头到脚被紧紧捆绑，并用胶带蒙住了眼睛。

sentences.en: No officer was able to successfully dial the number while in the same condition.
sentences.zh: 没有警员能在同样的状态下成功拨出号码。

sentences.en: Investigators also uncovered evidence that Caroline had attempted to book herself and her daughter into a hotel on the night of her murder.
sentences.zh: 调查人员还发现了证据，表明卡罗琳在遇害当晚曾试图为自己和女儿预订酒店。

sentences.en: A text she sent to a friend around this time revealed why.
sentences.zh: 她在大约同一时间发给朋友的一条短信揭示了原因。

sentences.en: Caroline had threatened to leave her husband.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳威胁要离开她的丈夫。

sentences.en: Babis and Ognostopoulos had been on holiday in Alonisos when he first met Caroline Crouch.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯在阿洛尼索斯度假时第一次遇见了卡罗琳·克劳奇。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: His mother lived on the island and was a teacher at the school Caroline attended.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲住在岛上，是卡罗琳就读学校的一名老师。

sentences.en: Caroline was just 15 years old when Babis introduced himself.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯自我介绍时，卡罗琳年仅15岁。

sentences.en: He was 27.
sentences.zh: 他当时27岁。

sentences.en: Described as charismatic, clever and photogenic, he was also well off financially.
sentences.zh: 他被描述为富有魅力、聪明且上镜，经济条件也很优越。

sentences.en: Babis gained Caroline's attention by flying his helicopter over the school.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯通过驾驶直升机飞过学校上空引起了卡罗琳的注意。

sentences.en: Despite the 12-year age gap,
sentences.zh: 尽管有12岁的年龄差，

sentences.en: Caroline believed she had found her perfect match and assured her family that she was happy.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳还是相信自己找到了完美伴侣，并向家人保证她很幸福。

sentences.en: Within a year and a half,
sentences.zh: 一年半之内，

sentences.en: Babis proposed to the then 17-year-old
sentences.zh: 巴比斯向当时17岁的

sentences.en: Caroline.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳求婚了。

sentences.en: Three days after Caroline turned 18, the pair exchanged vows and settled in Glickanera.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳年满18岁三天后，两人交换了誓言并在格利卡内拉定居。

sentences.en: Caroline attended university in Athens while Babis continued working as a pilot.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳在雅典上大学，而巴比斯继续担任飞行员。

sentences.en: Both Caroline and Babis were active on social media, sharing many photos and videos of their life together.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳和巴比斯在社交媒体上都很活跃，分享了许多他们共同生活的照片和视频。

sentences.en: Online, they looked like a joyful and romantic couple.
sentences.zh: 在网上，他们看起来是一对快乐而浪漫的夫妻。

sentences.en: Yet, Caroline was far more honest when writing in her private diary.
sentences.zh: 然而，卡罗琳在写私人日记时要诚实得多。

sentences.en: In coded entries dating back to 2019,
sentences.zh: 在追溯到2019年的加密日记中，

sentences.en: Caroline questioned her relationship with Babis.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳质疑了她与巴比斯的关系。

sentences.en: That year, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 那一年，她写道：

sentences.en: I fought with Babis again.
sentences.zh: 我又和巴比斯吵架了。

sentences.en: This time it was serious.
sentences.zh: 这次很严重。

sentences.en: I am thinking of leaving.
sentences.zh: 我在考虑离开。

sentences.en: I am thinking of going to my sister.
sentences.zh: 我在考虑去我姐姐那里。

sentences.en: I don't know if I can keep going with him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我是否还能和他继续下去。

sentences.en: Over time, Babis became increasingly manipulative and controlling towards Caroline.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，巴比斯对卡罗琳的操纵和控制欲日益增强。

sentences.en: It began with their very non-traditional wedding.
sentences.zh: 这始于他们非常非传统的婚礼。

sentences.en: Greek weddings are typically elaborate celebrations attended by a large crowd of family and well-wishers.
sentences.zh: 希腊婚礼通常是盛大的庆典，有大批亲友和祝福者参加。

sentences.en: However, Babis eloped with Caroline overseas in a guestless ceremony.
sentences.zh: 然而，巴比斯带着卡罗琳私奔到海外，举行了一场没有宾客的仪式。

sentences.en: Upon their return home,
sentences.zh: 回到家后，

sentences.en: Babis further isolated Caroline from her friends and family.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯进一步将卡罗琳与她的朋友和家人隔离开来。

sentences.en: He was also the breadwinner while Caroline was a university student with no money, making her totally dependent on him.
sentences.zh: 他还是家里的经济支柱，而卡罗琳只是一名没有钱的大学生，这使她完全依赖于他。

sentences.en: Whenever Caroline's mother sent her money,
sentences.zh: 每当卡罗琳的母亲给她寄钱时，

sentences.en: Babis would take it.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯就会把钱拿走。

sentences.en: Caroline wrote of her anguish in her diary.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳在日记中写下了她的痛苦。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引用如下：

sentences.en: I love Babis so much that I can't leave him, even though this relationship hurts me.
sentences.zh: 我太爱巴比斯了，以至于无法离开他，尽管这段关系让我受伤。

sentences.en: Caroline later detailed a tearful confrontation she had with Babis, wherein she expressed her desire to leave him.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳后来详细描述了她与巴比斯之间的一次含泪对峙，她在对峙中表达了离开他的愿望。

sentences.en: But she had just discovered she was pregnant with his child.
sentences.zh: 但她刚刚发现自己怀上了他的孩子。

sentences.en: Caroline wrote,
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳写道：

sentences.en: I stayed with him so my daughter would not grow up without her two parents.
sentences.zh: 我留在他身边，是为了让我的女儿不会在没有双亲的情况下长大。

sentences.en: In July 2020,
Caroline wrote,
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳写道：

sentences.en: Today my little one is a month old.
sentences.zh: 今天我的小宝贝满月了。

sentences.en: It's also the day I told Babis I want to leave.
sentences.zh: 这也是我告诉巴比斯我想离开的日子。

sentences.en: I feel awful.
sentences.zh: 我感觉糟透了。

sentences.en: She went on to write that she had found a house for herself in the Athens suburb of Herlandry.
sentences.zh: 她接着写道，她已经在雅典的赫兰德里郊区为自己找了一处房子。

sentences.en: Hours before Caroline was killed, phone records revealed that she and Babis had exchanged several combative texts while at home together.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗琳遇害前几小时，通话记录显示她和巴比斯在家中时曾交换过几条充满火药味的短信。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持Casefile继续提供高质量的内容。

sentences.en: Babis and Ognostopoulos was informed that the suspect who had emerged in his wife's murder investigation was in fact him.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯被告知，在他妻子谋杀案调查中浮出水面的嫌疑人其实就是他本人。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: He was presented with the overwhelming evidence that revealed the inconsistencies in his original story.
sentences.zh: 他被出示了压倒性的证据，这些证据揭示了他最初陈述中的前后矛盾之处。

sentences.en: After more than eight hours of interrogation,
sentences.zh: 经过八个多小时的审讯，

sentences.en: Babis broke down.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯崩溃了。

sentences.en: Babis confessed that on the night of Monday, May 10, 2021, he and Caroline had started arguing early on.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯供认，2021年5月10日星期一晚上，他和卡罗琳很早就开始争吵。

sentences.en: Although Caroline's diary entries indicated the couple had had issues from early in their relationship,
sentences.zh: 尽管卡罗琳的日记条目显示这对夫妇从关系初期就有问题，

sentences.en: Babis claimed they only ever thought about their daughter.
sentences.zh: 但巴比斯声称他们只考虑过他们的女儿。

sentences.en: He said that Caroline was determined to take their child and leave.
sentences.zh: 他说卡罗琳决心带着孩子离开。

sentences.en: This angered Babis, who claimed his daughter was his whole life.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了巴比斯，他声称女儿是他的一切。

sentences.en: He lost his temper.
sentences.zh: 他失去了理智。

sentences.en: Babis told police.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯告诉警察：

sentences.en: At some point,
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，

sentences.en: Caroline threw the child in her cot and she told me to get up and leave the house.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳把孩子扔进婴儿床，并叫我起来离开房子。

sentences.en: She pushed me and punched me.
sentences.zh: 她推了我，还打了我的拳头。

sentences.en: My judgment became blurred.
sentences.zh: 我的判断力变得模糊了。

sentences.en: I strangled her.
sentences.zh: 我勒死了她。

sentences.en: Caroline tried to fight Babis off as he pressed the pillow down on her face with the entire weight of his body.
sentences.zh: 当巴比斯用全身重量将枕头压在卡罗琳脸上时，她试图反抗。

sentences.en: He killed her in front of their 11-month-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 他在他们11个月大的女儿面前杀害了她。

sentences.en: Afterwards, Babis panicked.
sentences.zh: 事后，巴比斯惊慌失措。

sentences.en: He thought about getting rid of Caroline's body but said it was impossible for him to do so.
sentences.zh: 他想过处理掉卡罗琳的尸体，但说他无法做到。

sentences.en: He just looked at her and cried.
sentences.zh: 他只是看着她哭泣。

sentences.en: The thought then crossed his mind to say someone else killed Caroline.
sentences.zh: 随后他脑海中闪过一个念头，说是别人杀了卡罗琳。

sentences.en: He staged the home invasion, killing their puppy Roxy to bolster his story.
sentences.zh: 他伪造了入室抢劫现场，杀死了他们的小狗Roxy以支撑他的故事。

sentences.en: He knew no one would believe he was capable of killing his own dog.
sentences.zh: 他知道没人会相信他有能力杀死自己的狗。

sentences.en: Babis then placed his wailing baby daughter alongside the body of his wife before tying himself up with rope, duct tape and handcuffs.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯随后将哭泣的女儿放在妻子的尸体旁，然后用绳子、胶带和手铐把自己绑了起来。

sentences.en: Babis conceded that he deserved to be punished, saying,
sentences.zh: 巴比斯承认他罪有应得，他说：

sentences.en: I owe a big apology to the people I've hurt.
sentences.zh: 我欠那些被我伤害过的人一个巨大的道歉。

sentences.en: I know it doesn't matter now.
sentences.zh: 我知道现在说什么都没用了。

sentences.en: What I did was not justified.
sentences.zh: 我的所作所为是无法辩解的。

sentences.en: He did, however, try to shift blame onto Caroline by saying she had become unstable and aggressive since giving birth.
sentences.zh: 然而，他确实试图通过说卡罗琳自生下孩子后变得不稳定且具有攻击性，来将责任推卸给卡罗琳。

sentences.en: He made out that she was a terrible mother and implied that he had killed her to save their child.
sentences.zh: 他把她描绘成一个糟糕的母亲，并暗示他杀她是为救他们的孩子。

sentences.en: In Caroline, the murder that fooled the world, domestic abuse expert Dr. Emma Katz said,
sentences.zh: 在《卡罗琳：欺骗世界的谋杀案》中，家庭虐待专家艾玛·卡茨博士说：

sentences.en: This attempt to besmirch Caroline's character and make people think badly of her is of course an attempt to get Babis more sympathy and more lenient treatment,
sentences.zh: 这种试图玷污卡罗琳名声并让人们对她产生负面看法，当然是为了让巴比斯获得更多同情和更轻的处罚，

sentences.en: which goes completely against the narrative that he has any remorse or contrition for what he's done.
sentences.zh: 这完全违背了他对自己所作所为有任何悔意或愧疚的说法。

sentences.en: In reference to Babis painting Caroline out to be the aggressor,
sentences.zh: 关于巴比斯将卡罗琳描绘成施暴者，

sentences.en: Dr. Katz explained,
sentences.zh: 卡茨博士解释说：

sentences.en: We do often see victims arguing back and we see victims even physically fighting back against the coercive control.
sentences.zh: 我们确实经常看到受害者反驳，甚至看到受害者对强制控制进行身体反抗。

sentences.en: Sometimes people then think they can't be a real victim, they fought back.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会认为他们不是真正的受害者，因为他们反抗了。

sentences.en: Babis might have given the impression
sentences.zh: 巴比斯可能给人留下了这样的印象：

sentences.en: Caroline wasn't a real victim because she fought back, but in my opinion, she very much was.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳不是真正的受害者，因为她反抗了，但在我看来，她绝对是。

sentences.en: Babis said he lied to police because he didn't want his daughter to grow up without either of her parents.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯说他向警方撒谎是因为他不想让女儿在失去双亲的情况下长大。

sentences.en: I'm devastated, he said.
sentences.zh: 我心碎了，他说。

sentences.en: I only cared about my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我只关心我的女儿。

sentences.en: I hid the truth so I would be able to raise her.
sentences.zh: 我隐瞒了真相，这样我就能抚养她长大。

sentences.en: Greece's chief of police claimed that they had suspected
sentences.zh: 希腊警察局长声称他们从一开始就怀疑

sentences.en: Babis and Agnostopoulos from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: When police first arrived at his home,
sentences.zh: 当警察第一次到达他家时，

sentences.en: Babis was remarkably cold about his wife's murder.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯对他妻子的谋杀表现得异常冷漠。

sentences.en: His demeanour made one officer so uncomfortable, she took Babis' baby away from him.
sentences.zh: 他的举止让一位警官感到非常不安，以至于她把巴比斯的宝宝从他身边带走了。

sentences.en: Yet, any misgivings about Babis were kept private as investigators ruled out other possibilities.
sentences.zh: 然而，调查人员排除了其他可能性，因此对巴比斯的任何疑虑都秘而不宣。

sentences.en: They publicly refuted any suggestions he was responsible to prevent him from fleeing.
sentences.zh: 他们公开反驳了任何关于他有罪的猜测，以防他潜逃。

sentences.en: Babis was so confident that he had convinced police of his story that he didn't feel the need to destroy evidence, such as his mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯非常自信，认为自己已经让警方相信了他的说辞，所以他觉得没必要销毁证据，比如他的手机。

sentences.en: Babis cleverly blamed the crime on foreigners because he knew this would shift public discourse to the perpetrator's nationalities rather than the crime itself.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯狡猾地将罪行归咎于外国人，因为他知道这会把公众的讨论焦点从案件本身转移到肇事者的国籍上。

sentences.en: Authorities described Babis as a top-class actor.
sentences.zh: 当局形容巴比斯是一位顶级演员。

sentences.en: His willingness to speak to investigators and the media ensured he came across as a man with nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 他愿意配合调查人员和媒体，这确保了他给人的印象是一个问心无愧的人。

sentences.en: In front of news cameras, he convincingly played the role of grieving husband.
sentences.zh: 在新闻镜头前，他令人信服地扮演了一个悲痛欲绝的丈夫的角色。

sentences.en: Many viewers were fully convinced he was a man in pain.
sentences.zh: 许多观众完全相信他是一个痛苦的人。

sentences.en: Babis told the media,
sentences.zh: 巴比斯告诉媒体：

sentences.en: Take care of your family.
sentences.zh: 照顾好你的家人。

sentences.en: Cherish your loved ones as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 尽可能地珍惜你的爱人。

sentences.en: While the homicide investigation was underway,
sentences.zh: 在谋杀案调查进行期间，

sentences.en: Babis was active on social media, posting happy pictures of him and Caroline along with captions like,
sentences.zh: 巴比斯在社交媒体上很活跃，发布了他和卡罗琳的幸福照片，并配文说：

sentences.en: Together forever.
sentences.zh: 永远在一起。

sentences.en: He kept up this charade for over a month.
sentences.zh: 他维持这种伪装超过了一个月。

sentences.en: Caroline's mother,
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的母亲，

sentences.en: Susan, later revealed that she hadn't suspected her daughter's husband for a second.
sentences.zh: 苏珊后来透露，她一秒钟都没有怀疑过女儿的丈夫。

sentences.en: She had placed all her hopes in her son-in-law and was left full of anger upon his confession.
sentences.zh: 她把所有的希望都寄托在女婿身上，在他认罪后，她感到无比愤怒。

sentences.en: The word wife was promptly removed from Caroline Crouch's white marble headstone, leaving the words, to our much-loved mother and daughter.
sentences.zh: “妻子”这个词很快从卡罗琳·克劳奇的白色大理石墓碑上移除了，只留下了“献给我们挚爱的母亲和女儿”这些字样。

sentences.en: Babis was charged with premeditated murder.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯被控蓄意谋杀。

sentences.en: He also faced charges for perverting the course of justice, lying to authorities and animal abuse.
sentences.zh: 他还面临妨碍司法公正、向当局撒谎和虐待动物的指控。

sentences.en: Public opinion about Babis was so vitriolic that outside court he donned a bulletproof vest and was flanked by armed police.
sentences.zh: 公众对巴比斯的舆论非常尖刻，以至于在法庭外，他穿上了防弹背心，并由武装警察护送。

sentences.en: He was dubbed the most vile man in Greece, though not everyone agreed.
sentences.zh: 他被称为希腊最卑鄙的人，尽管并非所有人都同意这一点。

sentences.en: A small group of middle-aged women gathered at the court to support the alleged killer.
sentences.zh: 一小群中年妇女聚集在法院支持这位被控杀人犯。

sentences.en: One of the women told the Times,
sentences.zh: 其中一名妇女告诉《泰晤士报》：

sentences.en: By no means do I justify what he did, but he's quite handsome and dashing.
sentences.zh: 我绝不为他的所作所为辩护，但他确实很帅，很有魅力。

sentences.en: Another remarked,
sentences.zh: 另一位评论道：

sentences.en: He's quite sensitive, not the narcissist they paint him out to be.
sentences.zh: 他很敏感，并不是他们所描述的那种自恋者。

sentences.en: I think about him a lot.
sentences.zh: 我经常想起他。

sentences.en: I've collected pictures of him and pinned them on my bedroom wall.
sentences.zh: 我收集了他的照片，并把它们贴在卧室的墙上。

sentences.en: In court, prosecutors walked through Babis' actions leading up to and immediately after Caroline's murder.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，检察官梳理了巴比斯在卡罗琳遇害前后的行为。

sentences.en: They argued that each action, from removing the memory card in his home security camera to meticulously staging the crime scene, indicated someone acting calmly
sentences.zh: 他们指出，从移除家庭监控摄像头的存储卡到精心布置犯罪现场，每一个动作都表明他是一个冷静的人，

sentences.en: with pre-planned intent.
sentences.zh: 且有预谋。

sentences.en: The fact that Babis attacked Caroline as she slept showed the crime was premeditated and cold-blooded.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯在卡罗琳熟睡时袭击她，这表明犯罪是蓄意且冷血的。

sentences.en: In his day-long testimony,
sentences.zh: 在他长达一天的证词中，

sentences.en: Babis told the court, I ruined my life.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯告诉法庭：“我毁了我的人生。”

sentences.en: I ruined my family's life.
sentences.zh: “我毁了我家人的生活。”

sentences.en: I wish I could go back in time.
sentences.zh: “我希望我能回到过去。”

sentences.en: He called his marriage to Caroline a fairy tale and claimed that her happiness was his absolute priority.
sentences.zh: 他称自己与卡罗琳的婚姻是童话般的，并声称她的幸福是他绝对的优先事项。

sentences.en: He claimed that after Caroline became a mother, she turned moody and was prone to emotional outbursts.
sentences.zh: 他声称卡罗琳成为母亲后变得喜怒无常，容易情绪爆发。

sentences.en: This caused him to snap.
sentences.zh: 这导致他崩溃了。

sentences.en: Babis was expressionless as he detailed the night he killed Caroline.
sentences.zh: 巴比斯在详细描述他杀害卡罗琳的那晚时面无表情。

sentences.en: He claimed responsibility for her death but denied it was murder.
sentences.zh: 他承认对她的死负责，但否认是谋杀。

sentences.en: Maintaining the attack was a crime of passion done in the heat of the moment.
sentences.zh: 坚称这次袭击是一时冲动下的激情犯罪。

sentences.en: In May 2022, after a month-long trial, the jury unanimously found Babis and Ognostopoulos guilty of all charges.
sentences.zh: 2022年5月，经过一个月的审判，陪审团一致裁定巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯所有罪名成立。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: He was sentenced to life imprisonment.
sentences.zh: 他被判处终身监禁。

sentences.en: Prison life has been difficult for Babis and Ognostopoulos.
sentences.zh: 监狱生活对巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯来说很艰难。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: He has expressed fear for his life after being beaten by men of the nationalities he tried to pin his crimes on.
sentences.zh: 他曾表示担心自己的生命安全，因为他遭到了他试图嫁祸的那些国籍男子的殴打。

sentences.en: Caroline Crouch was one of 17 women killed by their romantic partner in Greece in 2021.
sentences.zh: 2021年，卡罗琳·克劳奇是希腊被伴侣杀害的17名女性之一。

sentences.en: In almost every instance, the victim had tried to end the relationship before her death.
sentences.zh: 在几乎每一个案例中，受害者在遇害前都曾试图结束这段关系。

sentences.en: These types of killings fall under the definition of femicide, the killing of women or girls because they are female.
sentences.zh: 这类杀戮属于“杀害女性”的定义，即因为女性身份而杀害妇女或女孩。

sentences.en: In almost 40% of reported femicide cases, the perpetrator is the victim's spouse or partner.
sentences.zh: 在近40%的已报告杀害女性案件中，肇事者是受害者的配偶或伴侣。

sentences.en: Issues of domestic abuse weren't openly discussed in Greece, meaning victims like Caroline Crouch suffered in silence.
sentences.zh: 希腊并没有公开讨论家庭虐待问题，这意味着像卡罗琳·克劳奇这样的受害者只能默默忍受。

sentences.en: A journalist appearing on the documentary,
sentences.zh: 一位出现在纪录片中的记者，

sentences.en: Caroline, the murder that fooled the world, said,
sentences.zh: 《卡罗琳：欺骗世界的谋杀案》中说道：

sentences.en: The only positive thing to come out of this case was that the term femicide has been introduced in the
sentences.zh: 这个案件带来的唯一积极影响是，“杀害女性”这个词被引入了

sentences.en: Greek media.
sentences.zh: 希腊媒体。

sentences.en: This case gave, tragically, an opportunity for the Greek society to realise how deep this problem is.
sentences.zh: 悲剧的是，这个案件让希腊社会有机会意识到这个问题的严重性。

sentences.en: I hope that this case will live long in the Greek society's memory because it will remind us of the many wrong perceptions we have about people and it will also remind us
sentences.zh: 我希望这个案件能长久地留在希腊社会的记忆中，因为它会提醒我们对人们存在许多错误的认知，也会提醒我们

sentences.en: how much we should look into the issue of domestic violence.
sentences.zh: 我们应该多么重视家庭暴力问题。

sentences.en: Before Caroline Crouch met Babas Anognostopoulos, she was a popular young woman renowned for always having a smile on her face.
sentences.zh: 在卡罗琳·克劳奇遇到巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯之前，她是一位受欢迎的年轻女性，以脸上总是挂着笑容而闻名。
zh_words: 巴比斯·阿纳格诺斯托普洛斯

sentences.en: Others immediately wanted to befriend her and she was so well liked that she was like a mini-celebrity in Alonisos.
sentences.zh: 其他人立刻想和她交朋友，她非常受欢迎，在阿洛尼索斯就像一个小名人。

sentences.en: A friend and former neighbour of Caroline's said,
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的一位朋友兼前邻居说：

sentences.en: I consider the people that hadn't met
sentences.zh: 我认为那些没见过

sentences.en: Caroline unlucky.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳的人是不幸的。

sentences.en: The loss is really great.
sentences.zh: 这种损失真的很大。

sentences.en: I really miss her.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想念她。

sentences.en: Caroline was also a loving and doting mother.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳也是一位充满爱心和慈爱的母亲。

sentences.en: In what would become the final video she ever posted to her
sentences.zh: 在她发布到

sentences.en: Instagram account,
sentences.zh: Instagram账户上的最后一段视频中，

sentences.en: Caroline is on the beach by her home joyfully holding her baby daughter in the air before planting a kiss on her cheek.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳在自家海滩上，开心地把女儿举在空中，然后在她脸颊上亲了一下。

sentences.en: The little girl is now being cared for by Caroline's parents,
sentences.zh: 这个小女孩现在由卡罗琳的父母照顾，

sentences.en: David and Susan, on the same Greek island where Caroline herself grew up.
sentences.zh: 大卫和苏珊，就在卡罗琳本人长大的那个希腊岛屿上。

sentences.en: When writing about her daughter in her diary,
sentences.zh: 当在日记中写到女儿时，

sentences.en: Caroline said,
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳说：

sentences.en: My love for her is stronger than anything in the world.
sentences.zh: 我对她的爱胜过世界上的一切。
